tagline: Predicted, recurring grocery replenishment from a photographed receipt.

epics.title: Capture core
epics.acceptance: A photographed receipt becomes a reviewable ingest job (A1).

epics.title: Canonicalization & matching
epics.acceptance: Repeat purchases resolve to one catalog item (A4).

epics.title: Review & commit
epics.acceptance: Upload a real receipt, review it, see items in inventory (Day 1 gate).

epics.title: Prediction engine
epics.acceptance: computeItemStats passes fixture unit tests; recompute runs on-commit and nightly.

epics.title: Validation harness
epics.acceptance: S3 scorecard (n>=4) clears >=70% overall (§12).

epics.title: Inventory & consumption
epics.acceptance: Marking an item used updates stock and Today (A8).

epics.title: Cadence planning
epics.acceptance: Manual override survives nightly recompute (A9).

epics.title: Shopping list
epics.acceptance: List generates from a bucket and exports as plain text.

epics.title: Capture polish & backdating
epics.acceptance: Three grouped screenshots produce one receipt, no triple-counting (A24).

epics.title: Manual entry & catalog management
epics.acceptance: Merging two catalog items consolidates movements and aliases (A12).

epics.title: Budget & insights
epics.acceptance: Forward spend projection derives from live cadences and prices.

epics.title: Notifications
epics.acceptance: Daily digest fires only when something is due within 3 days.

epics.title: Settings & cost controls
epics.acceptance: Cost meter reflects real per-receipt token/cost accounting; loop-bug guard halts at 100/day.

epics.title: PWA & ship polish
epics.acceptance: All §11 acceptance tests pass on the production URL (ship gate).

epics.title: Mobile navigation & design-system fidelity remediation
epics.acceptance: Every screen is reachable from a mobile-width viewport; Switch and Radio show a visible keyboard focus ring; every CHANGELOG-documented responsive collapse (filter trigger, sticky bars, tab scroll) is actually implemented; shared components consume design tokens instead of bypassing them with ad hoc values.

epics.title: Test infrastructure & regression coverage
epics.acceptance: npm test runs a unit suite covering computeItemStats (EWMA/shrinkage/outlier-rejection/bucketing), unit normalization, and rate_correction clamping, reproducing the hand-computed S-14a/c fixtures already recorded in docs/MANUAL-TESTS.md; npm run test:e2e passes the gate and gets a 200 on every route in this backlog plus one happy-path assertion per section, using accessible roles/names rather than DOM structure. Alias-hit/trigram matching and backdating-vs-stock_epoch commit behavior need a seeded-DB integration harness (S-47) and are tracked as a deferred follow-up, not silently dropped.

epics.title: Critical rendering hotfixes (found during REQ-30 audit)
epics.acceptance: Two P0 bugs found while auditing against design/screens/*.html, fixed same-day ahead of the formal audit epic since both were live, app-wide/severe: an unlayered CSS reset silently zeroing every Tailwind padding/margin utility in both themes, and an unhandled rejection hanging /review/[id] indefinitely for any receipt with a missing Storage object.

epics.title: Design fidelity remediation vs design/screens/*.html
epics.acceptance: Full-audit diff (live vs. design/screens/*.html reference, mobile + desktop) shows no unaddressed high/medium mismatch, excluding confirmed-intentional deviations (5-item mobile tab bar, Today's extra reachability quick-links, both from the E-16 IA decision).

epics.title: Authentication foundation
epics.acceptance: New email/password signup creates a household + owner household_members row and reaches onboarding (REQ-01) for a brand-new household; login/logout work via Supabase Auth server-side sessions; proxy.ts redirects unauthenticated navigation to /login with a 'next' param (resolves the audit's P0 gate dead-end -- a bare-text 401 with no way back to a login form) instead of a bare 401; anon Supabase key stays absent from the client bundle.

epics.title: Multi-tenant data isolation
epics.acceptance: RLS policies rewritten (new migration, disabled-policy migration left as historical record) to key off auth.uid() via household_members and ENABLEd on every household_id-scoped table; every user-facing Server Action/Route Handler/Server Component reads its household from a request-scoped client, not DEFAULT_HOUSEHOLD_ID; service-role client narrowed to api/cron/* and the REQ-23 seeder only; the cross-household isolation test (two households, one seeded item each, assert household A cannot read/write household B via any route) passes as the hard gate on this epic.

epics.title: Usability & flow-completeness fixes
epics.acceptance: Every P0/P1 finding from the v2 UX/flow-completeness audit is fixed with its own story acceptance below; no visual/token changes bundled here (REQ-29/E-23 scope).

epics.title: Design system v2 (tokens + mockups, G3)
epics.acceptance: docs/design/ v2 token set, updated component primitives, and key-screen mockups (covering every existing app/(app)/** and app/onboarding/** screen plus the new /login and /signup screens from E-20) exist and pass define-design's self-review (design-critique + WCAG AA a11y pass); G3 approved. Per-page implementation stories are seeded in a follow-up backlog reconcile once mockups exist -- writing testable per-page acceptance against mockups that do not exist yet would violate Definition of Ready, the same reason REQ-30 (E-19) worked against an already-approved reference rather than one authored in the same pass.

stories.title: Repo, Next.js 16 + App Router wiring, Vercel deploy
stories.acceptance: Empty app deployed to a Vercel URL within the first hour of Day 1.

stories.title: Full DB schema (incl. stock_epoch) + RLS written-but-disabled + seed data (categories, priors, ~300 items)
stories.acceptance: Migration applies cleanly; v_current_stock view returns correct sums against fixture movements.

stories.title: Passcode gate middleware (signed HTTP-only cookie)
stories.acceptance: Unauthenticated request without the gate cookie returns 401 (A26).

stories.title: Onboarding wizard: household config, shopping presets, optional stock tick-off
stories.acceptance: Tick-off creates initial stock movements and sets stock_epoch = now(); cold-start household shows a non-broken Today screen (A13).

stories.title: Multi-format capture UI: camera / file-picker / drag-drop (PDF, JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, HTML/MHTML)
stories.acceptance: Each supported format uploads and lands in Storage with a signed-URL-backed receipt row.

stories.title: Upload -> Storage -> ingest_jobs -> LLM extraction pipeline (Gemini Flash primary, native-PDF-text fast path)
stories.acceptance: A photographed grocery bill extracts >=85% of lines correctly (A1); native-text PDFs take the cheap text-only path, verifiable via parse_path (A22).

stories.title: Escalation ladder (Pro retry on schema/total-mismatch failure) + manual-entry fallback retaining raw response
stories.acceptance: Malformed LLM JSON escalates to Pro, then to manual entry, never a crash or silent data loss (A11).

stories.title: Duplicate protection via SHA-256 content_hash + soft warning on near-duplicate
stories.acceptance: Re-uploading the same file is blocked as duplicate (A2).

stories.title: Canonicalization: exact alias hit -> pg_trgm similarity -> LLM new-item proposal
stories.acceptance: Same product via receipt then manual entry under different raw text resolves to one catalog item, two aliases, purchase_count = 2 (A4).

stories.title: Unit normalization to base units (g/ml/piece) at write time
stories.acceptance: kg/l/dozen/pack-of-N/2x500ml all commit to correct base-unit quantities; ambiguous units default to piece/qty 1 and flag for review.

stories.title: Categorization against fixed seeded taxonomy + non-inventory row flagging
stories.acceptance: 20-line PDF order confirmation parses with delivery fee and GST excluded as non-inventory (A3).

stories.title: Review queue split view: mandatory purchase date, stock_epoch past-order banner
stories.acceptance: A document with no extractable date blocks commit; setting a date manually releases it (A21).

stories.title: Commit -> purchase ledger movements + price history + stats-recompute trigger
stories.acceptance: Committed receipt's items appear in inventory in correct base-unit quantities (Day 1 gate, A1).

stories.title: Interval estimation: EWMA, outlier rejection, shrinkage-to-category-prior
stories.acceptance: Intervals computed from purchase events, outliers rejected (|x-median|>3.5xMAD, n>=3 only, working spec Sec5 step 3 -- lowered from the doc's literal n>=5, which disables the rule at exactly the data volume its own stated purpose (one vacation/bulk-buy) targets; see ledger), EWMA'd (alpha=0.35, step 4), shrunk toward category prior by w=n/(n+2) (step 5) — fixture-tested in isolation against known interval sequences.

stories.title: Rate-based cross-check + perishability clamp
stories.acceptance: daily_rate_base computed from trailing-120d quantities; blended with interval_est by data-quality weight q into next_purchase; perishability_days caps depletion_date where set (working spec Sec5 steps 6-7).

stories.title: Confidence, cadence bucketing + hysteresis, persist item_stats + fixture unit tests
stories.acceptance: Day 0/7/14/21 fixture buckets weekly, confidence Medium (~0.50 under the literal n/(n+3) formula with n=3 usable intervals -- doc's worked example says 'High' but that's prose, not a purpose-backed rule; the formula constant is algorithm detail and wins per AGENTS.md, see ledger), next purchase ~= day 28 (A5, with qtyBase omitted so q=0 and the assertion isolates interval estimation); one outlier interval (vacation/bulk-buy) doesn't move the bucket (A6); 2-purchase fixture (n=1 usable interval) is prior-dominated, confidence Learning (~0.25 <0.35) and therefore bucket=unpredictable by step 9's compound condition, not a numeric cadence bucket (A7); bucket only changes when interval_est crosses the adjacent boundary by >15% (hysteresis; unpredictable transitions are unhysteresised, see ledger); item_stats + item_stats_history (last 5) persisted.

stories.title: Repurchase reconciliation loop (rate_correction, clamp [0.5, 2.0])
stories.acceptance: Projected stock >40% of pack size multiplies rate_correction by 0.85; projected stock <=0 for >20% of the interval multiplies it by 1.15; cumulative correction clamped to [0.5, 2.0] (working spec Sec5/F9.3). Only runs when the committed receipt is the chronologically latest purchase on record for that item — a backdated commit (S-27) updates interval/frequency stats only. Additionally gated on at least one recorded consumption/adjustment/waste movement existing for the item (see ledger) — without one, the depletion baseline predicted_depletion_at is anchored on an unboundedly-accumulating raw ledger sum (no F9.1/F9.2 consumption tracking exists until E-7) and reconciling against it walks rate_correction to the 0.5 floor on ordinary real usage; verified via live-Supabase reproduction before this guard was added.

stories.title: Recompute triggers: on-commit (affected items) + nightly 03:00 IST cron (all items)
stories.acceptance: item_stats_history retains the last 5 recomputes per item.

stories.title: Synthetic history seeder (7 cohorts, is_demo household only, ENABLE_SEED gate)
stories.acceptance: npm run seed:history generates ~70 items across 7 cohorts (working spec Sec12) into a dedicated is_demo household with known ground-truth cadence/interval metadata, spanning up to computeItemStats' own 24-month lookback window (not a literal fixed 12 months -- see ledger); npm run seed:history -- --wipe removes all of that household's data in one command; every write is guarded to refuse touching any household other than the fixed demo id with is_demo=true.

stories.title: Validation scorecard (npm run validate:predictions) + tune alpha/shrinkage/MAD/hysteresis against S3
stories.acceptance: Overall S3 (n>=4 purchases, i.e. >=5 total events per item since one is held out) clears >=70%, printed per-cohort (§12 scorecard); half_yearly/yearly clean_periodic items are structurally excluded from the S3 average by computeItemStats' own 24-month lookback, not a seeding defect (see ledger). Live result: 78% overall PASS, after fixing a real computeRateCrossCheck double-counting bug found by the harness (see ledger).

stories.title: Inventory screen (grouped, filterable, searchable) + item detail with plain-language prediction explanation
stories.acceptance: Item card shows current stock, predicted days remaining, cadence badge, last purchased, avg price, trend sparkline.

stories.title: Consumption actions (used it up / used some / wasted) + implicit virtual depletion projection
stories.acceptance: "Used it up" zeroes stock and surfaces the item in Today (A8); virtual depletion never writes a ledger movement.

stories.title: Plan screen: cadence bucket tabs, suggested qty, snooze/skip/exclude/override with revert-to-auto
stories.acceptance: Manual cadence override survives nightly recompute; revert-to-auto restores computed value (A9).

stories.title: Today view (everything due within 3 days across all buckets, default landing screen)
stories.acceptance: Cold-start household with zero data shows a useful, non-broken Today screen (A13).

stories.title: Shopping list generation (per-bucket or due-in-N-days) + plain-text export
stories.acceptance: List exports as plain text/clipboard for sharing.

stories.title: Check-off-to-purchase-log with price prompt
stories.acceptance: Checking an item off without a receipt still writes a purchase movement when a price is entered.

stories.title: Multi-image-as-one-order grouping toggle (2-3 screenshots -> one multimodal call)
stories.acceptance: Three screenshots grouped as one order produce a single receipt with no triple-counted items (A24).

stories.title: Clipboard paste (Cmd/Ctrl+V) capture entry point
stories.acceptance: Clipboard paste opens Add with the pasted image staged (A25).

stories.title: Multi-file queue (N files -> N receipts, sequential review with counter) + backdating flow
stories.acceptance: A backdated receipt (dated before stock_epoch) updates frequency stats but not current stock (A18).

stories.title: Paste-text capture routed to a cheaper text-only LLM call
stories.acceptance: Pasted order-confirmation email body parses via the text-only path, not multimodal.

stories.title: Manual entry: searchable typeahead over catalog, recency-ranked, last-quantity prefilled
stories.acceptance: Repeating a common purchase takes two taps.

stories.title: Catalog manager (merge / archive / recategorize)
stories.acceptance: Merging two catalog items reassigns aliases and movements to the survivor and recomputes stats correctly (A12).

stories.title: Insights screen: spend vs. budget by category, forward spend projection, top-10 items, price alerts, waste report
stories.acceptance: Forward projection of next month's committed recurring spend derives directly from live cadences and prices.

stories.title: Daily 07:00 IST digest + weekly Sunday 18:00 IST list-ready email (Resend) + in-app badges
stories.acceptance: Digest only fires when something is actually due within 3 days.

stories.title: Settings screen: household config, category management pointer, CSV/JSON export, demo-data wipe
stories.acceptance: Data export produces valid CSV/JSON; demo-data wipe only touches is_demo-flagged rows.

stories.title: Cost meter + loop-bug guard (100 receipts/day hard stop, alert at 50, per-receipt token/cost accounting)
stories.acceptance: Ingestion actually halts at the daily threshold; Settings shows month-to-date LLM spend, per-receipt average, count by model tier.

stories.title: PWA manifest + installability (Android Web Share Target)
stories.acceptance: App is installable; offline shell caches but data does not sync offline.

stories.title: Error/empty/loading states, mobile pass, dark mode
stories.acceptance: Every screen defines an error, empty, and loading state (no blank/broken renders); full mobile-viewport pass; dark mode functional across the app.

stories.title: Security pass + full acceptance-test ship-gate verification
stories.acceptance: Anon Supabase key absent from client bundle (grep build output); unauthenticated request without the gate cookie returns 401 (A26); all §11 acceptance tests (A1-A26) pass on the production URL (ship gate).

stories.title: Mobile reachability + focus-ring/functional blockers
stories.acceptance: Settings and Shopping List gain a direct link reachable from Today (or another always-visible surface) on mobile; Catalog and Review remain reachable even when their conditional link is absent (empty review queue); Switch and Radio both show a visible focus-visible ring on keyboard Tab; the gate passcode cookie works on http://localhost; a catalog merge-preview RPC failure surfaces a visible error instead of leaving Confirm merge silently disabled forever.

stories.title: Mobile top bar component + rollout
stories.acceptance: A new components/ui MobileTopBar (title + optional back button) renders below the lg breakpoint on every app/(app) route with the screen's title; Review Detail and Inventory Detail show a working back button.

stories.title: Documented mobile responsive collapses (filter bar, tabs, sticky bars)
stories.acceptance: Below 768px: Inventory's filter bar collapses behind a single "Filters (N active)" trigger; Plan's bucket Tabs scroll horizontally instead of wrapping, and per-item actions collapse to Snooze/Skip + overflow; Catalog's Merge selected button and Review Detail's Commit button are pinned to the viewport bottom instead of scrolling with content.

stories.title: Shared money formatter + consume/display bug fixes
stories.acceptance: A single lib/format money helper (thousands-grouped, 2dp, en-IN) replaces every ad hoc ₹ formatting call site across Insights, Review, Inventory, Shopping list; Review Detail's matched-line subtitle shows human-formatted qty/unit via the existing formatBaseQty helper instead of raw numbers; the Inventory item-detail Log button rejects amount<=0 with a visible validation message instead of silently no-op'ing; Sparkline's default tone reverts to neutral instead of hardcoded brand red.

stories.title: Component/token fidelity pass (Button, Table/ListRow typography, labels, a11y, reduced motion)
stories.acceptance: Button's secondary variant has an active/pressed state and destructive variant's color-mix recipe matches the design source; Table and ListRow consume the --text-body-sm composite token (incl. its 768px shrink) instead of a hardcoded font-size; Add·Manual's new-item fields and Review Detail's EditableLineFields all have accessible labels; Table column headers carry scope="col"; the shimmer keyframe respects prefers-reduced-motion.

stories.title: Test runner setup (vitest + Playwright wired to package.json)
stories.acceptance: npm test runs vitest against a red-then-green trivial smoke assertion; npm run test:e2e runs a Playwright config pointed at a locally-started dev server with the gate passcode wired from .env.local; both scripts exit non-zero on failure so they're CI-usable later.

stories.title: Prediction-engine unit tests (computeItemStats fixtures)
stories.acceptance: Unit tests reproduce the three MANUAL-TESTS.md S-14a/b/c fixtures verbatim: day 0/7/14/21 purchases bucket weekly with confidence ~0.50 and next-purchase ~day 28; day 0/7/60/67 rejects the 60-day outlier and stays weekly; a 2-purchase item is prior-dominated with confidence ~0.25 and bucket=unpredictable. A same-Kolkata-day duplicate purchase collapses into one event before interval math runs.

stories.title: Canonicalization/matching + unit-normalization unit tests
stories.acceptance: Unit tests cover lib/receipts/canonicalize.ts's two pure functions in isolation: normalizeText's casing/whitespace/punctuation normalization, and normalizeUnitToBase across mixed units (kg, l, dozen, pack-of-N, '2 x 500ml') producing correct base-unit quantities, with a nonsense unit string producing qty_base=1 and ambiguous=true (caller demotes review_state). Alias-hit/trigram-similarity matching (matchCatalogItem, runCanonicalization) is DB-bound (Supabase RPC + pg_trgm), out of scope for this story -- deferred to a future integration-test story against a local Supabase instance, not folded in here (deviation from the original story framing; see epic ledger).

stories.title: Commit/backdating + rate_correction unit tests
stories.acceptance: Unit tests (mocked Supabase client, no live DB) cover lib/predictions/reconcile.ts's reconcileRateCorrection arithmetic in isolation: multiplier selects DOWN (0.85) when remaining-projected-stock exceeds 40% of pack size, UP (1.15) when elapsed-since-depletion exceeds 20% of the interval, no-op when neither threshold fires or no prior purchase/consumption-signal exists, and the cumulative result is clamped to [0.5, 2.0]. Backdating-vs-stock_epoch itself lives in the commit_receipt SQL RPC, not TypeScript -- covered by S-46's E2E suite instead of a unit test (deviation from the original story framing, discovered while reading lib/review/commit.ts; see epic ledger).

stories.title: E2E route smoke suite (gate auth, every route, one happy path per section)
stories.acceptance: A Playwright suite authenticates through /gate once, then asserts every route in this backlog's shipped epics (Today, Add, Add/manual, Catalog, Insights, Inventory, Inventory/[id], Plan, Review, Review/[id], Settings, Shopping-list, Onboarding) returns 200 and renders its expected heading role/name; one happy-path interaction per section (e.g. Plan: click a bucket tab and see it become active) using accessible roles/names, not CSS selectors, so it survives the REQ-29 redesign. Backdating-vs-stock_epoch (A18) is deferred to S-47 -- it needs a seeded-DB integration harness this story does not build (see epic ledger).

stories.title: Seeded-DB integration harness (alias matching + backdating commit)
stories.acceptance: A test-only Supabase service-role seed/cleanup helper inserts and tears down fixture rows (catalog_items, receipts, receipt_lines, stock_movements, item_aliases) against the household configured in .env.local without corrupting the demo household's row counts that REQ-23's npm run validate:predictions depends on. Covers: matchCatalogItem's exact-alias-hit and pg_trgm fuzzy-match/miss bands (deferred from S-44), and commit_receipt's backdating behavior -- a backdated receipt (purchased_at < household.stock_epoch) committed without the past-order override leaves current stock unaffected; committed with the override, an extra 'initial' movement dated now() makes it affected (A18, deferred from S-46). Both deferred here together since they need the same seeded-DB infrastructure, not two separate harnesses.

stories.title: pdf-parse's DOMMatrix ReferenceError breaks the native-PDF-text fast path
stories.acceptance: Confirmed via production runtime-error logs: 'Failed to load external module pdf-parse-...: ReferenceError: DOMMatrix is not defined' on /add, because pdf-parse's dependency expects a browser DOM API not present in the serverless Node runtime. extractPdfText() catches the error and returns null (no crash), but looksLikeRealDocument(null) is always false, so every native-text PDF silently falls back to the more expensive multimodal path -- violating REQ-24's stated fast-path behavior (verifiable via parse_path, A22). Needs a Node-compatible PDF text extraction path (e.g. pdfjs-dist's legacy Node build, or a DOMMatrix polyfill) -- found during the REQ-30 audit, not yet fixed.

stories.title: Notifications (REQ-20) are configured-off: RESEND_API_KEY unset
stories.acceptance: This is a credential/config gap, not a code bug -- digest.ts already handles the unset case gracefully (returns {sent:false, reason:'RESEND_API_KEY not configured'}). Confirmed RESEND_API_KEY and RESEND_FROM_EMAIL are blank in .env.local and were already noted as unconfigured in production in E-14's own ledger. Needs a real Resend account + API key from the user -- not something to build around.

stories.title: Unlayered CSS reset was zeroing every padding/margin utility app-wide
stories.acceptance: app/globals.css's `* { padding: 0; margin: 0; }` reset moved inside @layer base so it no longer unconditionally beats every Tailwind spacing utility; verified via computed-style inspection (MobileTopBar's px-4: 0px -> 16px) in both themes, and visually across Today/Add/Review/Insights/Catalog/Settings.

stories.title: Missing receipt Storage object hung /review/[id] indefinitely
stories.acceptance: The document/text preview fetch in app/(app)/review/[id]/page.tsx degrades to the existing 'No preview available.' fallback on failure instead of an unhandled rejection stalling the whole page; reproduced pre-fix (60s+, never resolved) and confirmed resolved post-fix (~4s, renders correctly).

stories.title: Inventory list: remove duplicate title wrapper, restore out-of-stock badge
stories.acceptance: app/(app)/inventory/page.tsx's filter bar no longer wraps in an extra Card with a duplicate 'Inventory' title/description (design/screens/08-inventory-list.html has FilterBarWeb/FilterTriggerMobile unwrapped, directly on the page background). Out-of-stock item rows show a Badge tone="error" ("Out of stock") as the trailing element instead of an always-rendered blank Sparkline (matching OutOfStockCard in the reference). The extra third meta line on item rows (vs. the reference's two-item meta) is removed or justified in the story's own notes if kept.

stories.title: Plan: fix 'Always exclude' button variant
stories.acceptance: app/(app)/plan/plan-item-actions.tsx's 'Always exclude' button uses variant="ghost" (matching design/screens/10-plan.html:127), not variant="destructive" -- a low-emphasis action should not carry primary/destructive visual weight.

stories.title: Settings: full-width Save button, resolve Manage catalog alignment
stories.acceptance: settings-form.tsx's Save button is a direct flex-col child of its Card (matching the reference's full-width primary CTA) instead of wrapped in a horizontal flex row that prevents it from stretching. The 'Manage catalog' link's self-start alignment (settings/page.tsx) is reconciled against the reference's centered/full-width tertiary-button treatment -- if self-start turns out to be a deliberate app-wide convention used consistently elsewhere, this story documents that finding instead of changing it blind.

stories.title: Review queue: verify row density and mobile merchant-name color post-hotfix
stories.acceptance: Re-audit review-queue table row padding and mobile merchant-name color against design/screens/06-review-queue.html now that S-48's padding fix has landed (both findings were flagged before that fix; likely already resolved). Fix only what's still actually wrong post-verification, don't re-fix what S-48 already handled.

stories.title: Supabase Auth + household_members schema migration
stories.acceptance: New migration adds household_members(household_id, user_id, role, created_at), composite PK (household_id, user_id), FKs to households and auth.users. Supabase Auth (email+password provider) confirmed enabled on the project. No RLS changes in this migration (that is E-21/S-60) -- schema only.

stories.title: Signup: Server Action creates auth user + household + owner membership, redirects into onboarding
stories.acceptance: POST to the signup Server Action with email+password creates a Supabase Auth user, a new households row, and a household_members row (role='owner') in one transaction, then redirects to /onboarding (REQ-01) -- signup does not duplicate onboarding's household-config questions. Duplicate email is rejected with a clear inline error, no partial rows left behind.

stories.title: Login/logout: Server Actions + /login page
stories.acceptance: signInWithPassword runs server-side via a Server Action bound to next/headers cookies(); wrong password is rejected with a clear error and no session set; logout clears the session cookie. Anon key confirmed absent from the client bundle (build-output check, replaces A26).

stories.title: Session gate: replace passcode proxy.ts/lib/gate.ts with Supabase-session check
stories.acceptance: proxy.ts checks for a valid Supabase session instead of the signed passcode cookie; unauthenticated navigation redirects to /login?next=<path> (fixes the audit's P0 finding: a bare 401 with no link back to a login form); unauthenticated API/data requests still get 401. Static-asset/api/cron/* exemption list carries over unchanged. /gate route, lib/gate.ts, GATE_COOKIE_SECRET removed, not kept as a fallback.

stories.title: RLS policy rewrite: key on auth.uid() via household_members, enable RLS
stories.acceptance: New migration (supabase/migrations/..._rls_household_members.sql, not an edit to the disabled-policy migration) drops the current_setting-keyed policies and creates 'household_id in (select household_id from household_members where user_id = auth.uid())' policies for every table in the original disabled-policy migration's scope, then ALTER TABLE ... ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on each. categories stays exempt (no household_id column).

stories.title: Request-scoped Supabase client + getCurrentHouseholdId()
stories.acceptance: lib/supabase/server.ts gains createRequestClient() (@supabase/ssr server client bound to cookies()) alongside the existing createServiceClient(). lib/household.ts's getDefaultHouseholdId() is replaced by getCurrentHouseholdId(), sourced from the signed-in user's household_members row via createRequestClient(), not DEFAULT_HOUSEHOLD_ID.

stories.title: Migrate capture/review/commit routes to the request-scoped client
stories.acceptance: Every Server Action/Route Handler/Server Component under app/(app)/add/**, app/(app)/review/**, and the ingest pipeline (lib/ingest/**) uses createRequestClient() + getCurrentHouseholdId() instead of createServiceClient()/DEFAULT_HOUSEHOLD_ID. Existing REQ-02..REQ-12/REQ-22/REQ-24 acceptance tests still pass unmodified.

stories.title: Migrate inventory/plan/shopping-list/insights routes to the request-scoped client
stories.acceptance: Every Server Action/Route Handler/Server Component under app/(app)/inventory/**, app/(app)/plan/**, app/(app)/shopping-list/**, and app/(app)/insights/** uses createRequestClient() + getCurrentHouseholdId(). Existing REQ-13..REQ-19 acceptance tests still pass unmodified.

stories.title: Migrate settings/catalog/onboarding routes to the request-scoped client
stories.acceptance: Every Server Action/Route Handler/Server Component under app/(app)/settings/**, the catalog manager, and app/onboarding/** uses createRequestClient() + getCurrentHouseholdId(). Existing REQ-01/REQ-09/REQ-21 acceptance tests still pass unmodified.

stories.title: Narrow service-role usage to cron + seeder; remove DEFAULT_HOUSEHOLD_ID
stories.acceptance: grep for createServiceClient() across app/ and lib/ (excluding api/cron/** and the seeder script) returns zero matches. DEFAULT_HOUSEHOLD_ID env var and lib/household.ts deleted, not kept as an unused fallback.

stories.title: Cross-household isolation E2E test (epic gate)
stories.acceptance: New e2e/isolation.spec.ts: seed two households (A, B) each with one item; log in as household A's user; assert every route (inventory, review, plan, shopping-list, insights, settings) shows only household A's data and any direct request for household B's row id (item detail, receipt, etc.) is denied, not just filtered from a list view. This is the hard merge gate for E-21 -- ship-epic does not proceed if it fails.

stories.title: Review queue: surface failed/stuck extractions, block commit on zero-line receipts
stories.acceptance: getReviewQueue() (lib/review/data.ts) lists receipts outside status='parsed' (processing/failed) with an explicit state, not silently filtering them out; review-detail.tsx renders a spinner for processing and a 'extraction failed -- retry or enter manually' state for failed, instead of the full editable UI; commit_receipt() and the Commit button both refuse a receipt with zero lines instead of marking it committed with no movements written.

stories.title: Review queue: correction path for confidently-wrong auto-matched lines
stories.acceptance: Trigram-matched lines (>=0.62 confidence) in review-detail.tsx are no longer inert -- they get the same edit affordance needs_review lines already have, so a wrong auto-match can be corrected before commit without the user having to discover the heavier Catalog-merge flow after the fact.

stories.title: Consistent confirmation for destructive/ledger-writing actions
stories.acceptance: Consume actions (used it up/wasted) and shopping-list regeneration get an explicit confirm step consistent with the rest of the app's pattern (not a raw window.confirm, not silent) -- one confirmation component/pattern reused across Settings wipe, Catalog merge, consume actions, and list regeneration instead of three inconsistent ones.

stories.title: Inventory: distinct empty state for cold-start vs. filtered-to-nothing
stories.acceptance: app/(app)/inventory/page.tsx shows a distinct cold-start empty state (household has zero items ever tracked, A13) instead of reusing 'No items match these filters / Clear filters', which is actively misleading when there are no filters active to clear.

stories.title: Mobile back navigation for non-tabbed pages
stories.acceptance: Shopping list, Catalog manager, Settings, and Review-queue pages set backHref on their MobileTopBar (none currently do) -- each is reachable only via inbound links today with no in-app way back except the OS gesture.

stories.title: Spec-parity polish pass (P2)
stories.acceptance: Plan page shows a running total/estimated cost across the visible bucket; item detail page gains cadence-override, staple, perishability, and archive controls (F8, currently only on the separate Catalog page); Insights' 'no budget set yet' state links to Settings; the gate/login submit button gets a disabled/pending state to prevent double-submit on slow networks.

stories.title: define-design G3 pass for REQ-29 v2 tokens + mockups
stories.acceptance: docs/design/ (v2) contains tokens.md, updated component primitive specs, and key-screen mockups for every app/(app)/**, app/onboarding/**, and the new /login + /signup screens; design-critique + WCAG AA a11y self-review pass; G3 approved by human review. This story is the enabler -- per-page implementation stories follow in a separate backlog reconcile once mockups exist.
